input.description: Samplesheet CSV: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, and optional control and variant_vcf; with --long_reads, sample, bam, and optional control and variant_vcf.

genome.description: Key of params.genomes to align against (for example GRCh38). Required unless --long_reads.

analysis.description: digenome pairs forward and reverse endpoints into DSBs; ndigenome calls isolated strand endpoints (SSBs, nicks).

outdir.description: Published results directory. Use a separate one for each run.

genome_blacklist.description: Optional BED or BED.gz of regions to skip, with BAM contig names and 0-based half-open coordinates.

ref_cache.description: Shared bwa-mem2 index cache, keyed by genome, FASTA SHA-256, and bwa-mem2 version.

keep_multimappers.description: Run bwa-mem2 with -a, count MAPQ-0 primary alignments (both minimum MAPQs and the support mean-MAPQ filter become 0), and turn off fastp low-complexity filtering. Each read still counts once, at its primary placement. With --long_reads only the MAPQ changes apply.

long_reads.description: Call long-read (ONT/PacBio) samples from aligned BAMs given in the samplesheet's bam column, skipping trimming and alignment. Both aligned ends of each read count, and the soft-clip and indel limits become 1.0.

cleavage_chunks.description: Coordinate chunks per sample, each called by a one-CPU task. Changes runtime, never results.

fastp_qualified_quality_phred.description: Minimum Phred score for a qualified base.

fastp_length_required.description: Discard reads shorter than this after trimming.

fastp_low_complexity_filter.description: Low-complexity filtering in Digenome mode. Always off in nDigenome mode and with --keep_multimappers.

fastp_complexity_threshold.description: fastp complexity threshold (percent) when low-complexity filtering is on.

fastp_extra_args.description: Extra arguments appended to the fastp command.

digenome_overhang.description: Expected forward-minus-reverse endpoint offset; the expected reverse endpoint is forward - overhang.

digenome_pair_window.description: A forward and reverse endpoint can pair when |reverse - (forward - overhang)| <= this.

digenome_min_mapq.description: Minimum MAPQ (>=) of counted alignments. 0 with --keep_multimappers.

digenome_forward_cutoff.description: Forward endpoint count must be > this.

digenome_reverse_cutoff.description: Reverse endpoint count must be > this.

digenome_depth_cutoff.description: Each strand's depth must be > this.

digenome_fraction_cutoff.description: Each strand's endpoint fraction must be > this.

digenome_pair_score_cutoff.description: digenome_pair_score must be > this. 1.1 is RGEN's 2.5 moved to this score's scale; the two scores' cutoffs are not interchangeable.

ndigenome_min_count.description: Focal endpoint count must be >= this. An opposite endpoint reaching this and the minimum fraction makes the call POSSIBLE_DSB.

ndigenome_min_fraction.description: Focal endpoint fraction of same-strand depth must be >= this.

ndigenome_min_mapq.description: Minimum MAPQ (>=) of counted alignments. 0 with --keep_multimappers.

ndigenome_opposite_window.description: Search this many bases on each side for opposite-strand endpoints.

ndigenome_ambiguous_min_count.description: An opposite endpoint with count >= this makes the call AMBIGUOUS.

ndigenome_ambiguous_min_fraction.description: An opposite endpoint with fraction >= this makes the call AMBIGUOUS.

cleavage_artifact_window.description: Bases on each side of an endpoint used for MAPQ, mismatch, indel, clipping, and known-indel checks.

cleavage_max_softclip_fraction.description: HIGH_5P_SOFTCLIP when the fraction of supporting reads clipped at the end that forms the endpoint (the 5' end for short reads) is >= this.

cleavage_max_indel_fraction.description: NEARBY_INDEL when the fraction of local alignments with a nearby indel is >= this.

cleavage_min_support_mean_mapq.description: LOW_SUPPORT_MAPQ when supporting reads' mean MAPQ is < this. 0 with --keep_multimappers.

cleavage_control_min_depth.description: INSUFFICIENT_CONTROL_COVERAGE when the control depth is < this.

cleavage_control_max_fraction.description: HIGH_CONTROL_FRACTION when the control endpoint fraction is > this.

cleavage_control_min_fold.description: LOW_CONTROL_FOLD when the treated/control fold enrichment is < this.

cleavage_control_max_q.description: CONTROL_Q_FAIL when the sample-wide Benjamini-Hochberg q-value is > this.
